    function safeDecode(x) {
      try {
        return decodeURIComponent(x);
      } catch (e) {
        return x;
      }
    }

    function getCookie(name) {
      var m = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(^|;\\s*)' + name.replace(/[-[\]{}()*+?.,\\^$|#\s]/g, '\\$&') + '=([^;]*)'));
      return m ? m[2] : '';
    }

    function expireCookie(name) {
      var isHttps = location.protocol === 'https:';
      var secure = isHttps ? ' Secure;' : '';
      var base = (location.hostname || '').replace(/^www\./i, '');
      var domains = [
        '', // host-only
        location.hostname, // exact host
        '.' + base, // parent domain, common case
        base, // some stacks set without leading dot
      ];

      // If you know the canonical root domain, add it explicitly for safety.
      // Example:
      // domains.push(".immersivelabs.com", "immersivelabs.com");

      for (var i = 0; i < domains.length; i++) {
        var d = domains[i];
        var domainAttr = d ? ' domain=' + d + ';' : '';
        document.cookie = name + '=;' + ' expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT;' + ' Max-Age=0;' + ' path=/;' + domainAttr + ' SameSite=Lax;' + secure;
      }
    }

    function looksMalicious(value) {
      // Decode once so "onerror%3D" becomes "onerror="
      var v = safeDecode(value || '');

      // Obvious injection/XSS fragments or characters you never want in an ID cookie.
      if (/(onerror|onload|javascript:|<|>|"|\'|=|script)/i.test(v)) return true;

      // This allows typical token/ID-like strings and rejects weird characters.

      return /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,200}$/.test(v);

<!-- HATCH - Remove Header On Pagination + Dynamic Pagination Meta Title START -->
<script>
  (function () {
    // Run as early as possible, before DOMContentLoaded
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    let paginatedPageNumber = null;

    // Detect Webflow CMS pagination query parameters, e.g. ?793c1a11_page=2
    for (const [key, value] of urlParams.entries()) {
      if (/_page$/.test(key)) {
        const pageNumber = parseInt(value, 10);

        if (!isNaN(pageNumber) && pageNumber > 1) {
          paginatedPageNumber = pageNumber;
          console.log(`📄 Pagination detected early: ${key} = ${value}`);
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // Only run changes on paginated pages beyond page 1
    if (paginatedPageNumber) {
      // 1. Update document title to avoid duplicate title signals
      function updatePaginationTitle() {
        const currentTitle = document.title || '';

        if (!currentTitle) return;

        // Prevent duplicate "Page X" additions if the script runs more than once
        const cleanTitle = currentTitle
          .replace(/\s\|\sPage\s\d+$/i, '')
          .replace(/\s-\sPage\s\d+$/i, '')
          .trim();

        const updatedTitle = `${cleanTitle} | Page ${paginatedPageNumber}`;

        document.title = updatedTitle;

        // Optional: keep social title meta tags aligned if they exist
        const ogTitle = document.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]');
        if (ogTitle) {
          ogTitle.setAttribute('content', updatedTitle);
        }

        const twitterTitle = document.querySelector('meta[name="twitter:title"]');
        if (twitterTitle) {
          twitterTitle.setAttribute('content', updatedTitle);
        }

        console.log(`🟢 Updated page title to: ${updatedTitle}`);
      }

      // Run title update immediately
      updatePaginationTitle();

      // 2. Hide the header/content block as early as possible
      const style = document.createElement('style');
      style.innerHTML = `.hideonpagnation { display: none !important; }`;
      document.head.appendChild(style);

      // 3. Remove duplicated content fully once DOM is ready
      window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        // Run title update again in case Webflow/title injection happens later
        updatePaginationTitle();

        const header = document.querySelector('.hideonpagnation');

        if (header) {
          header.remove();
          console.log('🟢 Removed .hideonpagnation element early.');
        } else {
          console.log('ℹ️ Pagination detected, but .hideonpagnation element not found on DOMContentLoaded.');
        }
      });
    }
  })();
</script>
<!-- HATCH - Remove Header On Pagination + Dynamic Pagination Meta Title END -->

<!-- HATCH - Sticky Nav Elements Offset START -->
<script>
  (function () {
    const VAR_NAME = '--navheight';
    const SELECTOR = '.imm-nav';

    function setNavHeight() {
      const nav = document.querySelector(SELECTOR);
      if (!nav) return;
      // Use getBoundingClientRect for sub-pixel accuracy
      const h = Math.round(nav.getBoundingClientRect().height);
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(VAR_NAME, h + 'px');
    }

    // Debounce for window resize
    let rAF = null;
    function onResizeDebounced() {
      if (rAF) cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(setNavHeight);
    }

    // Run early, then again after full load for font shifts
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      setNavHeight();
      // One more tick once layout settles
      requestAnimationFrame(setNavHeight);
    });

    window.addEventListener('load', setNavHeight);
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResizeDebounced);

    // Watch the nav itself for dynamic height changes
    if ('ResizeObserver' in window) {
      const nav = document.querySelector(SELECTOR);
      if (nav) {
        const ro = new ResizeObserver(setNavHeight);
        ro.observe(nav);
      }
    }
  })();
</script>
<!-- HATCH - Sticky Nav Elements Offset END -->

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const DEFAULT_BASE = window.location.origin + '/resources/webinars/';

    document.querySelectorAll('.cms-dynamic-link').forEach((container) => {
      const externalLink = container.getAttribute('data-external-link');
      const baseUrl = container.getAttribute('data-base-url');
      const utmParams = container.getAttribute('data-utm');

      const links = container.querySelectorAll('a');

      links.forEach((link) => {
        let finalHref = link.getAttribute('href'); // Default fallback from Webflow

        // :white_check_mark: Case 1: Use external link (always takes priority)
        if (externalLink && externalLink.trim() !== '') {
          finalHref = externalLink;

          // Append UTM if it's provided (non-empty)
          if (utmParams && utmParams.trim() !== '') {
            const separator = finalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
            finalHref += separator + utmParams.replace(/^\?/, '');
          }

          link.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
          link.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
        }

        // :white_check_mark: Case 2: No external, but use baseUrl for internal CMS content
        else if (baseUrl && baseUrl.trim() !== '') {
          finalHref = `${DEFAULT_BASE}${baseUrl}${utmParams ? utmParams : ''}`;
        }

        // :white_check_mark: Case 3: Only UTM present
        else if (utmParams && utmParams.trim() !== '') {
          const separator = finalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
          finalHref += separator + utmParams.replace(/^\?/, '');
        }

        // Apply final href
        link.setAttribute('href', finalHref);
      });
    });
  });
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const COPY_ICON = `

  <path stroke="none" d="M0 0h24v24H0z"/>

  <path d="M16 8V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v8a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h2"/>
</svg>`;

    const CHECK_ICON = `
<svg width="25" height="25" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="#22c55e" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
  <path stroke="none" d="M0 0h24v24H0z"/>
  <path d="M5 12l5 5l10 -10"/>
</svg>`;

    function ready(fn) {
      if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    ready(function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('.w-code-block').forEach(function (block) {
        if (block.querySelector('.copy-btn')) return;

        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.innerHTML = COPY_ICON;
        btn.classList.add('copy-btn');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy code');

        const feedback = document.createElement('div');
        feedback.textContent = 'Code Copied';
        feedback.classList.add('copy-feedback');

        block.appendChild(btn);
        block.appendChild(feedback);

        btn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
          const clone = block.cloneNode(true);

          clone.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn, .copy-feedback').forEach(function (el) {
            el.remove();
          });

          const codeText = clone.innerText.trim();

          try {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(codeText);

            btn.innerHTML = CHECK_ICON;
            feedback.style.opacity = '1';

            setTimeout(function () {
              btn.innerHTML = COPY_ICON;
              feedback.style.opacity = '0';
            }, 1500);
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Failed to copy!', err);
          }
        });
      });
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    function ready(fn) {
      if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    ready(function () {
      const sections = document.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaways-section');

      sections.forEach(function (section, sectionIndex) {
        if (section.dataset.keyTakeawaysReady === 'true') return;

        const source = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-source');
        const tabsWrap = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-tabs');
        const panelsWrap = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-panels');

        if (!source || !tabsWrap || !panelsWrap) return;

        const listItems = Array.from(source.querySelectorAll('li'))
          .map(function (item) {
            return item.innerHTML.trim();
          })
          .filter(Boolean);

        if (!listItems.length) {
          section.style.display = 'none';
          source.remove();
          return;
        }

        tabsWrap.innerHTML = '';
        panelsWrap.innerHTML = '';

        listItems.forEach(function (content, index) {
          const number = String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0');
          const panelId = 'key-takeaway-panel-' + sectionIndex + '-' + index;

          const tab = document.createElement('button');
          tab.type = 'button';
          tab.className = 'key-takeaway-tab';
          tab.textContent = number;
          tab.setAttribute('aria-controls', panelId);
          tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', index === 0 ? 'true' : 'false');

          const panel = document.createElement('div');
          panel.className = 'key-takeaway-panel';
          panel.id = panelId;
          panel.setAttribute('role', 'tabpanel');
          panel.innerHTML = content;

          if (index === 0) {
            tab.classList.add('is-active');
            panel.classList.add('is-active');
          } else {
            panel.hidden = true;
          }

          tab.addEventListener('click', function () {
            const allTabs = tabsWrap.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaway-tab');
            const allPanels = panelsWrap.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaway-panel');

<script>
  (function () {
    const TOC_HOST_SELECTOR = '#toc';
    const RTE_SELECTOR = '.rich-text-cms.w-richtext';
    const HEADING_SELECTOR = 'h2, h3';
    const EXTRA_HEADING_SELECTOR = '.key-Takeaways_Header';
    const EXTRA_HEADING_TEXT = 'key takeaways';
    const TOC_TITLE_TEXT = 'Table of contents';
    const OFFSET = 112;

    function ready(fn) {
      if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    function cleanHeadingText(node) {
      const clone = node.cloneNode(true);

      clone.querySelectorAll('br').forEach(function (br) {
        br.remove();
      });

      return (clone.textContent || '')
        .replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
    }

    function normaliseText(text) {
      return (text || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }

    function slugify(text) {
      return text
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/&[^;]+;/g, '')
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-_]/g, '')
        .trim()
        .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
        .replace(/-+/g, '-');
    }

    function isHeading(el) {
      if (!el || !el.tagName) return false;

      const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();

      return tag === 'h2' || tag === 'h3';
    }

    function resolveHeading(el) {
      if (!el) return null;

      if (isHeading(el)) return el;

      const childHeading = el.querySelector(HEADING_SELECTOR);

      if (childHeading) return childHeading;

      return el;
    }

    function getHeadingLevel(el) {
      if (!el || !el.tagName) return 'h2';

      const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();

      if (tag === 'h3') return 'h3';

      return 'h2';
    }

    function getBestRichTextBlock() {
      const rteBlocks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(RTE_SELECTOR));

      if (!rteBlocks.length) return null;

      return rteBlocks
        .map(function (rte) {
          return {
            rte: rte,
            headings: Array.from(rte.querySelectorAll(HEADING_SELECTOR)),
          };
        })
        .sort(function (a, b) {
          return b.headings.length - a.headings.length;
        })[0];
    }

    function isAfterElement(target, reference) {
      return !!(target && reference && reference.compareDocumentPosition(target) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING);
    }

    function getExtraHeadingsByClass(rte) {
      if (!rte) return [];

      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(EXTRA_HEADING_SELECTOR))
        .map(resolveHeading)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .filter(function (heading) {
          return !rte.contains(heading) && isAfterElement(heading, rte);
        });
    }

    function getExtraHeadingsByText(rte) {
      if (!rte) return [];

      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(HEADING_SELECTOR)).filter(function (heading) {
        const title = normaliseText(cleanHeadingText(heading));
        const isTargetHeading = title === EXTRA_HEADING_TEXT;
        const isOutsideRichText = !rte.contains(heading);
        const isAfterRichText = isAfterElement(heading, rte);

        return isTargetHeading && isOutsideRichText && isAfterRichText;
      });
    }

    function getExtraHeadings(rte) {
      const byClass = getExtraHeadingsByClass(rte);
      const byText = getExtraHeadingsByText(rte);

      return [...byClass, ...byText];
    }

    function getExistingWrapper(heading) {
      if (heading.parentElement && heading.parentElement.classList.contains('ScrollOffset')) {
        return heading.parentElement;
      }

      return null;
    }

    function ensureUniqueId(baseId, usedIds, currentWrapper) {
      let id = baseId || 'section';
      let count = 2;

      while (usedIds.has(id) || (document.getElementById(id) && document.getElementById(id) !== currentWrapper)) {
        id = `${baseId || 'section'}-${count}`;
        count++;
      }

      usedIds.add(id);
      return id;
    }

    function ensureWrappedWithId(heading, id) {
      const existingWrapper = getExistingWrapper(heading);

      if (existingWrapper) {
        existingWrapper.id = id;
        heading.removeAttribute('id');
        return existingWrapper;
      }

      const wrapper = document.createElement('div');

      wrapper.id = id;
      wrapper.classList.add('ScrollOffset');

      heading.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, heading);
      wrapper.appendChild(heading);
      heading.removeAttribute('id');

      return wrapper;
    }

    function buildItems(headings) {
      const usedIds = new Set();

      const hasAnyH2 = headings.some(function (heading) {
        return getHeadingLevel(heading) === 'h2';
      });

      return headings
        .map(function (heading) {
          const title = cleanHeadingText(heading);
          if (!title) return null;

          const level = getHeadingLevel(heading);
          const existingWrapper = getExistingWrapper(heading);

          const baseId = existingWrapper && existingWrapper.id ? existingWrapper.id : heading.id ? heading.id : slugify(title);

          const id = ensureUniqueId(baseId, usedIds, existingWrapper);
          const wrapper = ensureWrappedWithId(heading, id);

          return {
            id: wrapper.id,
            title: title,
            level: level,
            isIndented: hasAnyH2 && level === 'h3',
          };
        })
        .filter(Boolean);
    }

    function buildToc(items) {
      const container = document.createElement('div');

      container.classList.add('toc-links');

      items.forEach(function (item) {
        const link = document.createElement('a');

        link.href = `#${item.id}`;
        link.textContent = item.title;
        link.classList.add('toc-link');

        if (item.isIndented) {
          link.classList.add('toc-link--h3');
        }

        container.appendChild(link);
      });

      return container;
    }

    function run() {
      const tocHost = document.querySelector(TOC_HOST_SELECTOR);
      if (!tocHost) return;

      const bestBlock = getBestRichTextBlock();

      if (!bestBlock || !bestBlock.headings.length) {
        tocHost.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      const headings = [...bestBlock.headings, ...getExtraHeadings(bestBlock.rte)];

      const uniqueHeadings = headings.filter(function (heading, index, array) {
        return array.indexOf(heading) === index;
      });

      const items = buildItems(uniqueHeadings);

      if (items.length <= 1) {
        tocHost.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      tocHost.style.display = '';
      tocHost.innerHTML = '';

      const tocTitle = document.createElement('div');
      tocTitle.textContent = TOC_TITLE_TEXT;
      tocTitle.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      tocTitle.classList.add('toc-title');
      tocHost.appendChild(tocTitle);

      const tocLinksContainer = buildToc(items);
      tocHost.appendChild(tocLinksContainer);

      const divider = document.createElement('div');
      divider.classList.add('toc-divider');
      divider.setAttribute('role', 'presentation');
      tocHost.appendChild(divider);

      const links = Array.from(tocLinksContainer.querySelectorAll('a'));

      const sections = items
        .map(function (item) {
          return document.getElementById(item.id);
        })
        .filter(Boolean);

      let ticking = false;

      function updateActive() {
        ticking = false;

        let activeId = sections[0] ? sections[0].id : null;

        for (const section of sections) {
          const top = section.getBoundingClientRect().top - OFFSET;

          if (top <= 0) {
            activeId = section.id;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }

        links.forEach(function (link) {
          const isActive = link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + activeId;
          link.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
        });
      }

      function onScrollOrResize() {
        if (ticking) return;

        ticking = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(updateActive);
      }

      window.addEventListener('scroll', onScrollOrResize, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('resize', onScrollOrResize);
      window.addEventListener('hashchange', onScrollOrResize);

      const fontsReady = document.fonts && document.fonts.ready ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve();

      fontsReady.then(function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(updateActive);
      });
    }

    ready(run);
  })();
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const DEFAULT_BASE = window.location.origin + '/resources/webinars/';

    document.querySelectorAll('.cms-dynamic-link').forEach((container) => {
      const externalLink = container.getAttribute('data-external-link');
      const baseUrl = container.getAttribute('data-base-url');
      const utmParams = container.getAttribute('data-utm');

      const links = container.querySelectorAll('a');

      links.forEach((link) => {
        let finalHref = link.getAttribute('href'); // Default fallback from Webflow

        // :white_check_mark: Case 1: Use external link (always takes priority)
        if (externalLink && externalLink.trim() !== '') {
          finalHref = externalLink;

          // Append UTM if it's provided (non-empty)
          if (utmParams && utmParams.trim() !== '') {
            const separator = finalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
            finalHref += separator + utmParams.replace(/^\?/, '');
          }

          link.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
          link.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
        }

        // :white_check_mark: Case 2: No external, but use baseUrl for internal CMS content
        else if (baseUrl && baseUrl.trim() !== '') {
          finalHref = `${DEFAULT_BASE}${baseUrl}${utmParams ? utmParams : ''}`;
        }

        // :white_check_mark: Case 3: Only UTM present
        else if (utmParams && utmParams.trim() !== '') {
          const separator = finalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
          finalHref += separator + utmParams.replace(/^\?/, '');
        }

        // Apply final href
        link.setAttribute('href', finalHref);
      });
    });
  });
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const COPY_ICON = `
<svg width="25" height="25" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="#555" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
  <path stroke="none" d="M0 0h24v24H0z"/>
  <rect x="8" y="8" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/>
  <path d="M16 8V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v8a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h2"/>
</svg>`;

    const CHECK_ICON = `
<svg width="25" height="25" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="#22c55e" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
  <path stroke="none" d="M0 0h24v24H0z"/>
  <path d="M5 12l5 5l10 -10"/>
</svg>`;

    function ready(fn) {
      if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    ready(function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('.w-code-block').forEach(function (block) {
        if (block.querySelector('.copy-btn')) return;

        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.innerHTML = COPY_ICON;
        btn.classList.add('copy-btn');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy code');

        const feedback = document.createElement('div');
        feedback.textContent = 'Code Copied';
        feedback.classList.add('copy-feedback');

        block.appendChild(btn);
        block.appendChild(feedback);

        btn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
          const clone = block.cloneNode(true);

          clone.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn, .copy-feedback').forEach(function (el) {
            el.remove();
          });

          const codeText = clone.innerText.trim();

          try {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(codeText);

            btn.innerHTML = CHECK_ICON;
            feedback.style.opacity = '1';

            setTimeout(function () {
              btn.innerHTML = COPY_ICON;
              feedback.style.opacity = '0';
            }, 1500);
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Failed to copy!', err);
          }
        });
      });
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    function ready(fn) {
      if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    ready(function () {
      const sections = document.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaways-section');

      sections.forEach(function (section, sectionIndex) {
        if (section.dataset.keyTakeawaysReady === 'true') return;

        const source = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-source');
        const tabsWrap = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-tabs');
        const panelsWrap = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-panels');

        if (!source || !tabsWrap || !panelsWrap) return;

        const listItems = Array.from(source.querySelectorAll('li'))
          .map(function (item) {
            return item.innerHTML.trim();
          })
          .filter(Boolean);

        if (!listItems.length) {
          section.style.display = 'none';
          source.remove();
          return;
        }

        tabsWrap.innerHTML = '';
        panelsWrap.innerHTML = '';

        listItems.forEach(function (content, index) {
          const number = String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0');
          const panelId = 'key-takeaway-panel-' + sectionIndex + '-' + index;

          const tab = document.createElement('button');
          tab.type = 'button';
          tab.className = 'key-takeaway-tab';
          tab.textContent = number;
          tab.setAttribute('aria-controls', panelId);
          tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', index === 0 ? 'true' : 'false');

          const panel = document.createElement('div');
          panel.className = 'key-takeaway-panel';
          panel.id = panelId;
          panel.setAttribute('role', 'tabpanel');
          panel.innerHTML = content;

          if (index === 0) {
            tab.classList.add('is-active');
            panel.classList.add('is-active');
          } else {
            panel.hidden = true;
          }

          tab.addEventListener('click', function () {
            const allTabs = tabsWrap.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaway-tab');
            const allPanels = panelsWrap.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaway-panel');

            allTabs.forEach(function (tabItem) {
              tabItem.classList.remove('is-active');
              tabItem.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
            });

            allPanels.forEach(function (panelItem) {
              panelItem.classList.remove('is-active');
              panelItem.hidden = true;
            });

            tab.classList.add('is-active');
            tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

            panel.classList.add('is-active');
            panel.hidden = false;
          });

          tabsWrap.appendChild(tab);
          panelsWrap.appendChild(panel);
        });

        source.remove();
        section.dataset.keyTakeawaysReady = 'true';
      });
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const TOC_HOST_SELECTOR = '#toc';
    const RTE_SELECTOR = '.rich-text-cms.w-richtext';
    const HEADING_SELECTOR = 'h2, h3';
    const EXTRA_HEADING_SELECTOR = '.key-Takeaways_Header';
    const EXTRA_HEADING_TEXT = 'key takeaways';
    const TOC_TITLE_TEXT = 'Table of contents';
    const OFFSET = 112;

    function ready(fn) {
      if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    function cleanHeadingText(node) {
      const clone = node.cloneNode(true);

      clone.querySelectorAll('br').forEach(function (br) {
        br.remove();
      });

      return (clone.textContent || '')
        .replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
    }

    function normaliseText(text) {
      return (text || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }

    function slugify(text) {
      return text
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/&[^;]+;/g, '')
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-_]/g, '')
        .trim()
        .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
        .replace(/-+/g, '-');
    }

    function isHeading(el) {
      if (!el || !el.tagName) return false;

      const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();

      return tag === 'h2' || tag === 'h3';
    }

    function resolveHeading(el) {
      if (!el) return null;

      if (isHeading(el)) return el;

      const childHeading = el.querySelector(HEADING_SELECTOR);

      if (childHeading) return childHeading;

      return el;
    }

    function getHeadingLevel(el) {
      if (!el || !el.tagName) return 'h2';

      const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();

      if (tag === 'h3') return 'h3';

      return 'h2';
    }

    function getBestRichTextBlock() {
      const rteBlocks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(RTE_SELECTOR));

      if (!rteBlocks.length) return null;

      return rteBlocks
        .map(function (rte) {
          return {
            rte: rte,
            headings: Array.from(rte.querySelectorAll(HEADING_SELECTOR)),
          };
        })
        .sort(function (a, b) {
          return b.headings.length - a.headings.length;
        })[0];
    }

    function isAfterElement(target, reference) {
      return !!(target && reference && reference.compareDocumentPosition(target) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING);
    }

    function getExtraHeadingsByClass(rte) {
      if (!rte) return [];

      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(EXTRA_HEADING_SELECTOR))
        .map(resolveHeading)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .filter(function (heading) {
          return !rte.contains(heading) && isAfterElement(heading, rte);
        });
    }

    function getExtraHeadingsByText(rte) {
      if (!rte) return [];

      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(HEADING_SELECTOR)).filter(function (heading) {
        const title = normaliseText(cleanHeadingText(heading));
        const isTargetHeading = title === EXTRA_HEADING_TEXT;
        const isOutsideRichText = !rte.contains(heading);
        const isAfterRichText = isAfterElement(heading, rte);

        return isTargetHeading && isOutsideRichText && isAfterRichText;
      });
    }

    function getExtraHeadings(rte) {
      const byClass = getExtraHeadingsByClass(rte);
      const byText = getExtraHeadingsByText(rte);

      return [...byClass, ...byText];
    }

    function getExistingWrapper(heading) {
      if (heading.parentElement && heading.parentElement.classList.contains('ScrollOffset')) {
        return heading.parentElement;
      }

      return null;
    }

    function ensureUniqueId(baseId, usedIds, currentWrapper) {
      let id = baseId || 'section';
      let count = 2;

      while (usedIds.has(id) || (document.getElementById(id) && document.getElementById(id) !== currentWrapper)) {
        id = `${baseId || 'section'}-${count}`;
        count++;
      }

      usedIds.add(id);
      return id;
    }

    function ensureWrappedWithId(heading, id) {
      const existingWrapper = getExistingWrapper(heading);

      if (existingWrapper) {
        existingWrapper.id = id;
        heading.removeAttribute('id');
        return existingWrapper;
      }

      const wrapper = document.createElement('div');

      wrapper.id = id;
      wrapper.classList.add('ScrollOffset');

      heading.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, heading);
      wrapper.appendChild(heading);
      heading.removeAttribute('id');

      return wrapper;
    }

    function buildItems(headings) {
      const usedIds = new Set();

      const hasAnyH2 = headings.some(function (heading) {
        return getHeadingLevel(heading) === 'h2';
      });

      return headings
        .map(function (heading) {
          const title = cleanHeadingText(heading);
          if (!title) return null;

          const level = getHeadingLevel(heading);
          const existingWrapper = getExistingWrapper(heading);

          const baseId = existingWrapper && existingWrapper.id ? existingWrapper.id : heading.id ? heading.id : slugify(title);

          const id = ensureUniqueId(baseId, usedIds, existingWrapper);
          const wrapper = ensureWrappedWithId(heading, id);

          return {
            id: wrapper.id,
            title: title,
            level: level,
            isIndented: hasAnyH2 && level === 'h3',
          };
        })
        .filter(Boolean);
    }

    function buildToc(items) {
      const container = document.createElement('div');

      container.classList.add('toc-links');

      items.forEach(function (item) {
        const link = document.createElement('a');

        link.href = `#${item.id}`;
        link.textContent = item.title;
        link.classList.add('toc-link');

        if (item.isIndented) {
          link.classList.add('toc-link--h3');
        }

        container.appendChild(link);
      });

      return container;
    }

    function run() {
      const tocHost = document.querySelector(TOC_HOST_SELECTOR);
      if (!tocHost) return;

      const bestBlock = getBestRichTextBlock();

      if (!bestBlock || !bestBlock.headings.length) {
        tocHost.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      const headings = [...bestBlock.headings, ...getExtraHeadings(bestBlock.rte)];

      const uniqueHeadings = headings.filter(function (heading, index, array) {
        return array.indexOf(heading) === index;
      });

      const items = buildItems(uniqueHeadings);

      if (items.length <= 1) {
        tocHost.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      tocHost.style.display = '';
      tocHost.innerHTML = '';

      const tocTitle = document.createElement('div');
      tocTitle.textContent = TOC_TITLE_TEXT;
      tocTitle.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      tocTitle.classList.add('toc-title');
      tocHost.appendChild(tocTitle);

      const tocLinksContainer = buildToc(items);
      tocHost.appendChild(tocLinksContainer);

      const divider = document.createElement('div');
      divider.classList.add('toc-divider');
      divider.setAttribute('role', 'presentation');
      tocHost.appendChild(divider);

      const links = Array.from(tocLinksContainer.querySelectorAll('a'));

      const sections = items
        .map(function (item) {
          return document.getElementById(item.id);
        })
        .filter(Boolean);

      let ticking = false;

      function updateActive() {
        ticking = false;

        let activeId = sections[0] ? sections[0].id : null;

        for (const section of sections) {
          const top = section.getBoundingClientRect().top - OFFSET;

          if (top <= 0) {
            activeId = section.id;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }

        links.forEach(function (link) {
          const isActive = link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + activeId;
          link.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
        });
      }

      function onScrollOrResize() {
        if (ticking) return;

        ticking = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(updateActive);
      }

      window.addEventListener('scroll', onScrollOrResize, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('resize', onScrollOrResize);
      window.addEventListener('hashchange', onScrollOrResize);

      const fontsReady = document.fonts && document.fonts.ready ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve();

      fontsReady.then(function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(updateActive);
      });
    }

    ready(run);
  })();

</svg></div></div></div><div itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemscope="" class="faq6_answer"><div class="margin-bottom-16 margin-small _1-5rem"><div class="max-width-large-10"><div itemprop="text" class="text-size-regular text-weight-light w-richtext"><p>Cybersecurity training is a structured program designed to educate individuals and teams on best practices for protecting digital assets, detecting threats, and responding to cyber incidents. It covers topics such as phishing awareness, password security, threat detection, and compliance requirements. Immersive provides hands-on, scenario-based training that helps organizations build cyber resilience by equipping employees with real-world skills to defend against evolving threats.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div itemtype="https://schema.org/Question" itemprop="mainEntity" itemscope="" role="listitem" class="faq6_accordion-3 w-variant-91278c52-b3fd-dc82-b45b-e6b226200f18 w-dyn-item"><div data-w-id="55b8ed5f-f07b-738d-6a81-8977257443fb" class="faq6_question main"><h3 itemprop="name" class="text-size-regular">Why is cybersecurity training important?</h3><div data-w-id="55b8ed5f-f07b-738d-6a81-8977257443fe" class="faq6_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small-16 w-embed"><svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<path d="M25.3333 15.667V16.3336C25.3333 16.7018 25.0349 17.0003 24.6667 17.0003H17V24.667C17 25.0351 16.7015 25.3336 16.3333 25.3336H15.6667C15.2985 25.3336 15 25.0351 15 24.667V17.0003H7.3333C6.96511 17.0003 6.66663 16.7018 6.66663 16.3336V15.667C6.66663 15.2988 6.96511 15.0003 7.3333 15.0003H15V7.33365C15 6.96546 15.2985 6.66699 15.6667 6.66699H16.3333C16.7015 6.66699 17 6.96546 17 7.33365V15.0003H24.6667C25.0349 15.0003 25.3333 15.2988 25.3333 15.667Z" fill="currentColor"/>
</svg></div></div></div><div itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemscope="" class="faq6_answer"><div class="margin-bottom-16 margin-small _1-5rem"><div class="max-width-large-10"><div itemprop="text" class="text-size-regular text-weight-light w-richtext"><p>Cybersecurity training is essential because it helps individuals and organizations defend against evolving cyber threats. Cyber attacks are becoming more sophisticated, and human error remains one of the biggest vulnerabilities. By providing structured training, businesses can reduce risks, improve security posture, and ensure compliance with industry regulations. Well-trained employees can recognize phishing attempts, use strong passwords, and respond effectively to security incidents, ultimately protecting sensitive data and business operations.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div itemtype="https://schema.org/Question" itemprop="mainEntity" itemscope="" role="listitem" class="faq6_accordion-3 w-variant-91278c52-b3fd-dc82-b45b-e6b226200f18 w-dyn-item"><div data-w-id="55b8ed5f-f07b-738d-6a81-8977257443fb" class="faq6_question main"><h3 itemprop="name" class="text-size-regular">Why is cybersecurity awareness training important?</h3><div data-w-id="55b8ed5f-f07b-738d-6a81-8977257443fe" class="faq6_icon-wrapper"><div class="icon-embed-small-16 w-embed"><svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

</svg></div></div></div><div itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemscope="" class="faq6_answer"><div class="margin-bottom-16 margin-small _1-5rem"><div class="max-width-large-10"><div itemprop="text" class="text-size-regular text-weight-light w-richtext"><p>Cybersecurity awareness training empowers employees to recognize and respond to potential threats before they become security incidents. Many cyber attacks exploit human error, such as clicking on malicious links or using weak passwords.     document.querySelectorAll('.cms-dynamic-link').forEach((container) => {

            finalHref += separator + utmParams.replace(/^\?/, '');
          }

          link.setAttribute('target', '_blank');

        // :white_check_mark: Case 2: No external, but use baseUrl for internal CMS content
        else if (baseUrl && baseUrl.trim() !== '') {
          finalHref = `${DEFAULT_BASE}${baseUrl}${utmParams ? utmParams : ''}`;

        // :white_check_mark: Case 3: Only UTM present
        else if (utmParams && utmParams.trim() !== '') {
          const separator = finalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
          finalHref += separator + utmParams.replace(/^\?/, '');

        // Apply final href

<script>
  (function () {

      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    ready(function () {
      const sections = document.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaways-section');

      sections.forEach(function (section, sectionIndex) {
        if (section.dataset.keyTakeawaysReady === 'true') return;

        const source = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-source');
        const tabsWrap = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-tabs');
        const panelsWrap = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-panels');

        if (!source || !tabsWrap || !panelsWrap) return;

        const listItems = Array.from(source.querySelectorAll('li'))
          .map(function (item) {
            return item.innerHTML.trim();
          })
          .filter(Boolean);

        if (!listItems.length) {
          section.style.display = 'none';
          source.remove();
          return;
        }

        tabsWrap.innerHTML = '';
        panelsWrap.innerHTML = '';

        listItems.forEach(function (content, index) {
          const number = String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0');
          const panelId = 'key-takeaway-panel-' + sectionIndex + '-' + index;

          const tab = document.createElement('button');
          tab.type = 'button';
          tab.className = 'key-takeaway-tab';
          tab.textContent = number;
          tab.setAttribute('aria-controls', panelId);
          tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', index === 0 ? 'true' : 'false');

          const panel = document.createElement('div');
          panel.className = 'key-takeaway-panel';
          panel.id = panelId;
          panel.setAttribute('role', 'tabpanel');
          panel.innerHTML = content;

          if (index === 0) {
            tab.classList.add('is-active');
            panel.classList.add('is-active');
          } else {
            panel.hidden = true;
          }

          tab.addEventListener('click', function () {
            const allTabs = tabsWrap.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaway-tab');
            const allPanels = panelsWrap.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaway-panel');

            allTabs.forEach(function (tabItem) {
              tabItem.classList.remove('is-active');
              tabItem.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
            });

            allPanels.forEach(function (panelItem) {
              panelItem.classList.remove('is-active');
              panelItem.hidden = true;
            });

            tab.classList.add('is-active');
            tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

            panel.classList.add('is-active');
            panel.hidden = false;
          });

          tabsWrap.appendChild(tab);
          panelsWrap.appendChild(panel);

        section.dataset.keyTakeawaysReady = 'true';
      });

<script>
  (function () {
    const TOC_HOST_SELECTOR = '#toc';
    const RTE_SELECTOR = '.rich-text-cms.w-richtext';
    const HEADING_SELECTOR = 'h2, h3';
    const EXTRA_HEADING_SELECTOR = '.key-Takeaways_Header';
    const EXTRA_HEADING_TEXT = 'key takeaways';
    const TOC_TITLE_TEXT = 'Table of contents';
    const OFFSET = 112;

    function ready(fn) {
      if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    function cleanHeadingText(node) {
      const clone = node.cloneNode(true);

      clone.querySelectorAll('br').forEach(function (br) {
        br.remove();
      });

      return (clone.textContent || '')
        .replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
    }

    function normaliseText(text) {
      return (text || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }

    function slugify(text) {
      return text
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/&[^;]+;/g, '')
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-_]/g, '')
        .trim()
        .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
        .replace(/-+/g, '-');
    }

    function isHeading(el) {
      if (!el || !el.tagName) return false;

      const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();

      return tag === 'h2' || tag === 'h3';
    }

    function resolveHeading(el) {
      if (!el) return null;

      if (isHeading(el)) return el;

      const childHeading = el.querySelector(HEADING_SELECTOR);

      if (childHeading) return childHeading;

      return el;
    }

    function getHeadingLevel(el) {
      if (!el || !el.tagName) return 'h2';

      const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();

      if (tag === 'h3') return 'h3';

      return 'h2';
    }

    function getBestRichTextBlock() {
      const rteBlocks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(RTE_SELECTOR));

      if (!rteBlocks.length) return null;

      return rteBlocks
        .map(function (rte) {
          return {
            rte: rte,
            headings: Array.from(rte.querySelectorAll(HEADING_SELECTOR)),
          };
        })
        .sort(function (a, b) {
          return b.headings.length - a.headings.length;
        })[0];
    }

    function isAfterElement(target, reference) {
      return !!(target && reference && reference.compareDocumentPosition(target) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING);
    }

    function getExtraHeadingsByClass(rte) {
      if (!rte) return [];

      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(EXTRA_HEADING_SELECTOR))
        .map(resolveHeading)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .filter(function (heading) {
          return !rte.contains(heading) && isAfterElement(heading, rte);
        });
    }

    function getExtraHeadingsByText(rte) {
      if (!rte) return [];

      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(HEADING_SELECTOR)).filter(function (heading) {
        const title = normaliseText(cleanHeadingText(heading));
        const isTargetHeading = title === EXTRA_HEADING_TEXT;
        const isOutsideRichText = !rte.contains(heading);
        const isAfterRichText = isAfterElement(heading, rte);

        return isTargetHeading && isOutsideRichText && isAfterRichText;
      });
    }

    function getExtraHeadings(rte) {
      const byClass = getExtraHeadingsByClass(rte);
      const byText = getExtraHeadingsByText(rte);

      return [...byClass, ...byText];
    }

    function getExistingWrapper(heading) {
      if (heading.parentElement && heading.parentElement.classList.contains('ScrollOffset')) {
        return heading.parentElement;
      }

      return null;
    }

    function ensureUniqueId(baseId, usedIds, currentWrapper) {
      let id = baseId || 'section';
      let count = 2;

      while (usedIds.has(id) || (document.getElementById(id) && document.getElementById(id) !== currentWrapper)) {
        id = `${baseId || 'section'}-${count}`;
        count++;
      }

      usedIds.add(id);
      return id;
    }

    function ensureWrappedWithId(heading, id) {
      const existingWrapper = getExistingWrapper(heading);

      if (existingWrapper) {
        existingWrapper.id = id;
        heading.removeAttribute('id');
        return existingWrapper;
      }

      const wrapper = document.createElement('div');

      wrapper.id = id;
      wrapper.classList.add('ScrollOffset');

      heading.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, heading);
      wrapper.appendChild(heading);
      heading.removeAttribute('id');

      return wrapper;
    }

    function buildItems(headings) {
      const usedIds = new Set();

      const hasAnyH2 = headings.some(function (heading) {
        return getHeadingLevel(heading) === 'h2';
      });

      return headings
        .map(function (heading) {
          const title = cleanHeadingText(heading);
          if (!title) return null;

          const level = getHeadingLevel(heading);
          const existingWrapper = getExistingWrapper(heading);

          const baseId = existingWrapper && existingWrapper.id ? existingWrapper.id : heading.id ? heading.id : slugify(title);

          const id = ensureUniqueId(baseId, usedIds, existingWrapper);
          const wrapper = ensureWrappedWithId(heading, id);

          return {
            id: wrapper.id,
            title: title,
            level: level,
            isIndented: hasAnyH2 && level === 'h3',
          };
        })
        .filter(Boolean);
    }

    function buildToc(items) {
      const container = document.createElement('div');

      container.classList.add('toc-links');

      items.forEach(function (item) {
        const link = document.createElement('a');

        link.href = `#${item.id}`;
        link.textContent = item.title;
        link.classList.add('toc-link');

        if (item.isIndented) {
          link.classList.add('toc-link--h3');
        }

        container.appendChild(link);
      });

      return container;
    }

    function run() {
      const tocHost = document.querySelector(TOC_HOST_SELECTOR);
      if (!tocHost) return;

      const bestBlock = getBestRichTextBlock();

      if (!bestBlock || !bestBlock.headings.length) {
        tocHost.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      const headings = [...bestBlock.headings, ...getExtraHeadings(bestBlock.rte)];

      const uniqueHeadings = headings.filter(function (heading, index, array) {
        return array.indexOf(heading) === index;
      });

      const items = buildItems(uniqueHeadings);

      if (items.length <= 1) {
        tocHost.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      tocHost.style.display = '';
      tocHost.innerHTML = '';

      const tocTitle = document.createElement('div');
      tocTitle.textContent = TOC_TITLE_TEXT;
      tocTitle.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      tocTitle.classList.add('toc-title');
      tocHost.appendChild(tocTitle);

      const tocLinksContainer = buildToc(items);
      tocHost.appendChild(tocLinksContainer);

      const divider = document.createElement('div');
      divider.classList.add('toc-divider');
      divider.setAttribute('role', 'presentation');
      tocHost.appendChild(divider);

      const links = Array.from(tocLinksContainer.querySelectorAll('a'));

      const sections = items
        .map(function (item) {
          return document.getElementById(item.id);
        })
        .filter(Boolean);

      let ticking = false;

      function updateActive() {
        ticking = false;

        let activeId = sections[0] ? sections[0].id : null;

        for (const section of sections) {
          const top = section.getBoundingClientRect().top - OFFSET;

          if (top <= 0) {
            activeId = section.id;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }

        links.forEach(function (link) {
          const isActive = link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + activeId;
          link.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
        });
      }

      function onScrollOrResize() {
        if (ticking) return;

        ticking = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(updateActive);
      }

      window.addEventListener('scroll', onScrollOrResize, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('resize', onScrollOrResize);
      window.addEventListener('hashchange', onScrollOrResize);

      const fontsReady = document.fonts && document.fonts.ready ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve();

      fontsReady.then(function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(updateActive);
      });
    }

    ready(run);
  })();
</script>

<script>
window.Webflow ||= [];

window.Webflow.push(() => {
  const defaultChars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{};:,.<>?";

  function escapeHTML(str) {
    return str
      .replace(/&/g, "&")
      .replace(/</g, "<")
      .replace(/>/g, ">")
      .replace(/"/g, """)
      .replace(/'/g, "'");
  }

  function initScramble(block, settingsSource = block) {
    if (!block || block.dataset.scrambleReady === "true") return;

    const textEl = block.matches("[data-scramble-text]")
      ? block
      : block.querySelector("[data-scramble-text]");

    if (!textEl) return;

    block.dataset.scrambleReady = "true";

    const finalText = textEl.textContent.trim();

    const chars =
      block.getAttribute("data-scramble-chars") ||
      settingsSource.getAttribute("data-scramble-chars") ||
      defaultChars;

    const triggerType =
      block.getAttribute("data-scramble-trigger") ||
      settingsSource.getAttribute("data-scramble-trigger") ||
      "scroll";

    const scrambleColor =
      block.getAttribute("data-scramble-start-color") ||
      settingsSource.getAttribute("data-scramble-start-color") ||
      "#3C64FF";

    const finalColor =
      block.getAttribute("data-scramble-end-color") ||
      settingsSource.getAttribute("data-scramble-end-color") ||
      "#FFFFFF";

    const frames =
      Number(
        block.getAttribute("data-scramble-frames") ||
        settingsSource.getAttribute("data-scramble-frames")
      ) || 36;

    const lockWidth =
      block.getAttribute("data-scramble-lock-width") === "true" ||
      settingsSource.getAttribute("data-scramble-lock-width") === "true";

    let isAnimating = false;
    let hasScrolled = false;
    let lockedWidth = null;

    textEl.innerHTML = `<span style="color:${finalColor};">${escapeHTML(finalText)}</span>`;

    function getRandomChar() {
      return chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
    }

    function lockBlockWidth() {
      if (!lockWidth) return;

      if (!lockedWidth) {
        lockedWidth = block.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      }

      block.style.width = `${lockedWidth}px`;
      block.style.minWidth = `${lockedWidth}px`;
    }

    function runScramble() {
      if (isAnimating) return;

      isAnimating = true;
      let frame = 0;

      lockBlockWidth();

      function scrambleFrame() {
        const progress = frame / frames;
        const revealedCount = Math.floor(finalText.length * progress);

        let output = "";

        finalText.split("").forEach((char, i) => {
          if (char === " ") {
            output += " ";
            return;
          }

          if (i < revealedCount) {
            output += `<span style="color:${finalColor};">${escapeHTML(char)}</span>`;
          } else {
            output += `<span style="color:${scrambleColor};">${escapeHTML(getRandomChar())}</span>`;
          }
        });

        textEl.innerHTML = output;
        frame++;

        if (frame <= frames) {
          requestAnimationFrame(scrambleFrame);
        } else {
          textEl.innerHTML = `<span style="color:${finalColor};">${escapeHTML(finalText)}</span>`;
          isAnimating = false;
        }
      }

      scrambleFrame();
    }

    function initScrollTrigger() {
      if (triggerType !== "scroll" && triggerType !== "both") return;

      if (window.gsap && window.ScrollTrigger) {
        gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

        ScrollTrigger.create({
          trigger: block,
          start: "top 95%",
          once: true,
          onEnter: () => {
            if (hasScrolled) return;
            hasScrolled = true;
            runScramble();
          }
        });

        ScrollTrigger.refresh();
        return;
      }

      if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
          (entries) => {
            entries.forEach((entry) => {
              if (!entry.isIntersecting || hasScrolled) return;

              hasScrolled = true;
              runScramble();
              observer.unobserve(block);
            });
          },
          {
            root: null,
            threshold: 0.1,

    function onResizeDebounced() {
      if (rAF) cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(setNavHeight);

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const DEFAULT_BASE = window.location.origin + '/resources/webinars/';

    document.querySelectorAll('.cms-dynamic-link').forEach((container) => {
      const externalLink = container.getAttribute('data-external-link');
      const baseUrl = container.getAttribute('data-base-url');
      const utmParams = container.getAttribute('data-utm');

      const links = container.querySelectorAll('a');

      links.forEach((link) => {
        let finalHref = link.getAttribute('href'); // Default fallback from Webflow

        // :white_check_mark: Case 1: Use external link (always takes priority)
        if (externalLink && externalLink.trim() !== '') {
          finalHref = externalLink;

          // Append UTM if it's provided (non-empty)
          if (utmParams && utmParams.trim() !== '') {
            const separator = finalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
            finalHref += separator + utmParams.replace(/^\?/, '');
          }

          link.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
          link.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
        }

        // :white_check_mark: Case 2: No external, but use baseUrl for internal CMS content
        else if (baseUrl && baseUrl.trim() !== '') {
          finalHref = `${DEFAULT_BASE}${baseUrl}${utmParams ? utmParams : ''}`;
        }

        // :white_check_mark: Case 3: Only UTM present
        else if (utmParams && utmParams.trim() !== '') {
          const separator = finalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
          finalHref += separator + utmParams.replace(/^\?/, '');
        }

        // Apply final href
        link.setAttribute('href', finalHref);
      });
    });
  });
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const COPY_ICON = `

  <path stroke="none" d="M0 0h24v24H0z"/>

  <path d="M16 8V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v8a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h2"/>
</svg>`;

    const CHECK_ICON = `
<svg width="25" height="25" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="#22c55e" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
  <path stroke="none" d="M0 0h24v24H0z"/>
  <path d="M5 12l5 5l10 -10"/>
</svg>`;

    function ready(fn) {
      if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    ready(function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('.w-code-block').forEach(function (block) {
        if (block.querySelector('.copy-btn')) return;

        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.innerHTML = COPY_ICON;
        btn.classList.add('copy-btn');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Copy code');

        const feedback = document.createElement('div');
        feedback.textContent = 'Code Copied';
        feedback.classList.add('copy-feedback');

        block.appendChild(btn);
        block.appendChild(feedback);

        btn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
          const clone = block.cloneNode(true);

          clone.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn, .copy-feedback').forEach(function (el) {
            el.remove();
          });

          const codeText = clone.innerText.trim();

          try {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(codeText);

            btn.innerHTML = CHECK_ICON;
            feedback.style.opacity = '1';

            setTimeout(function () {
              btn.innerHTML = COPY_ICON;
              feedback.style.opacity = '0';
            }, 1500);
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Failed to copy!', err);
          }
        });
      });
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    function ready(fn) {
      if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    ready(function () {
      const sections = document.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaways-section');

      sections.forEach(function (section, sectionIndex) {
        if (section.dataset.keyTakeawaysReady === 'true') return;

        const source = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-source');
        const tabsWrap = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-tabs');
        const panelsWrap = section.querySelector('.key-takeaways-panels');

        if (!source || !tabsWrap || !panelsWrap) return;

        const listItems = Array.from(source.querySelectorAll('li'))
          .map(function (item) {
            return item.innerHTML.trim();
          })
          .filter(Boolean);

        if (!listItems.length) {
          section.style.display = 'none';
          source.remove();
          return;
        }

        tabsWrap.innerHTML = '';
        panelsWrap.innerHTML = '';

        listItems.forEach(function (content, index) {
          const number = String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0');
          const panelId = 'key-takeaway-panel-' + sectionIndex + '-' + index;

          const tab = document.createElement('button');
          tab.type = 'button';
          tab.className = 'key-takeaway-tab';
          tab.textContent = number;
          tab.setAttribute('aria-controls', panelId);
          tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', index === 0 ? 'true' : 'false');

          const panel = document.createElement('div');
          panel.className = 'key-takeaway-panel';
          panel.id = panelId;
          panel.setAttribute('role', 'tabpanel');
          panel.innerHTML = content;

          if (index === 0) {
            tab.classList.add('is-active');
            panel.classList.add('is-active');
          } else {
            panel.hidden = true;
          }

          tab.addEventListener('click', function () {
            const allTabs = tabsWrap.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaway-tab');
            const allPanels = panelsWrap.querySelectorAll('.key-takeaway-panel');

<script>
  (function () {
    const TOC_HOST_SELECTOR = '#toc';
    const RTE_SELECTOR = '.rich-text-cms.w-richtext';
    const HEADING_SELECTOR = 'h2, h3';
    const EXTRA_HEADING_SELECTOR = '.key-Takeaways_Header';
    const EXTRA_HEADING_TEXT = 'key takeaways';
    const TOC_TITLE_TEXT = 'Table of contents';
    const OFFSET = 112;

    function ready(fn) {
      if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    function cleanHeadingText(node) {
      const clone = node.cloneNode(true);

      clone.querySelectorAll('br').forEach(function (br) {
        br.remove();
      });

      return (clone.textContent || '')
        .replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
    }

    function normaliseText(text) {
      return (text || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }

    function slugify(text) {
      return text
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/&[^;]+;/g, '')
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-_]/g, '')
        .trim()
        .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
        .replace(/-+/g, '-');
    }

    function isHeading(el) {
      if (!el || !el.tagName) return false;

      const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();

      return tag === 'h2' || tag === 'h3';
    }

    function resolveHeading(el) {
      if (!el) return null;

      if (isHeading(el)) return el;

      const childHeading = el.querySelector(HEADING_SELECTOR);

      if (childHeading) return childHeading;

      return el;
    }

    function getHeadingLevel(el) {
      if (!el || !el.tagName) return 'h2';

      const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();

      if (tag === 'h3') return 'h3';

      return 'h2';
    }

    function getBestRichTextBlock() {
      const rteBlocks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(RTE_SELECTOR));

      if (!rteBlocks.length) return null;

      return rteBlocks
        .map(function (rte) {
          return {
            rte: rte,
            headings: Array.from(rte.querySelectorAll(HEADING_SELECTOR)),
          };
        })
        .sort(function (a, b) {
          return b.headings.length - a.headings.length;
        })[0];
    }

    function isAfterElement(target, reference) {
      return !!(target && reference && reference.compareDocumentPosition(target) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING);
    }

    function getExtraHeadingsByClass(rte) {
      if (!rte) return [];

      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(EXTRA_HEADING_SELECTOR))
        .map(resolveHeading)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .filter(function (heading) {
          return !rte.contains(heading) && isAfterElement(heading, rte);
        });
    }

    function getExtraHeadingsByText(rte) {
      if (!rte) return [];

      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(HEADING_SELECTOR)).filter(function (heading) {
        const title = normaliseText(cleanHeadingText(heading));
        const isTargetHeading = title === EXTRA_HEADING_TEXT;
        const isOutsideRichText = !rte.contains(heading);
        const isAfterRichText = isAfterElement(heading, rte);

        return isTargetHeading && isOutsideRichText && isAfterRichText;
      });
    }

    function getExtraHeadings(rte) {
      const byClass = getExtraHeadingsByClass(rte);
      const byText = getExtraHeadingsByText(rte);

      return [...byClass, ...byText];
    }

    function getExistingWrapper(heading) {
      if (heading.parentElement && heading.parentElement.classList.contains('ScrollOffset')) {
        return heading.parentElement;
      }

      return null;
    }

    function ensureUniqueId(baseId, usedIds, currentWrapper) {
      let id = baseId || 'section';
      let count = 2;

      while (usedIds.has(id) || (document.getElementById(id) && document.getElementById(id) !== currentWrapper)) {
        id = `${baseId || 'section'}-${count}`;
        count++;
      }

      usedIds.add(id);
      return id;
    }

    function ensureWrappedWithId(heading, id) {
      const existingWrapper = getExistingWrapper(heading);

      if (existingWrapper) {
        existingWrapper.id = id;
        heading.removeAttribute('id');
        return existingWrapper;
      }

      const wrapper = document.createElement('div');

      wrapper.id = id;
      wrapper.classList.add('ScrollOffset');

      heading.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, heading);
      wrapper.appendChild(heading);
      heading.removeAttribute('id');

      return wrapper;
    }

    function buildItems(headings) {
      const usedIds = new Set();

      const hasAnyH2 = headings.some(function (heading) {
        return getHeadingLevel(heading) === 'h2';
      });

      return headings
        .map(function (heading) {
          const title = cleanHeadingText(heading);
          if (!title) return null;

          const level = getHeadingLevel(heading);
          const existingWrapper = getExistingWrapper(heading);

          const baseId = existingWrapper && existingWrapper.id ? existingWrapper.id : heading.id ? heading.id : slugify(title);

          const id = ensureUniqueId(baseId, usedIds, existingWrapper);
          const wrapper = ensureWrappedWithId(heading, id);

          return {
            id: wrapper.id,
            title: title,
            level: level,
            isIndented: hasAnyH2 && level === 'h3',
          };
        })
        .filter(Boolean);
    }

    function buildToc(items) {
      const container = document.createElement('div');

      container.classList.add('toc-links');

      items.forEach(function (item) {
        const link = document.createElement('a');

        link.href = `#${item.id}`;
        link.textContent = item.title;
        link.classList.add('toc-link');

        if (item.isIndented) {
          link.classList.add('toc-link--h3');
        }

        container.appendChild(link);
      });

      return container;
    }

    function run() {
      const tocHost = document.querySelector(TOC_HOST_SELECTOR);
      if (!tocHost) return;

      const bestBlock = getBestRichTextBlock();

      if (!bestBlock || !bestBlock.headings.length) {
        tocHost.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      const headings = [...bestBlock.headings, ...getExtraHeadings(bestBlock.rte)];

      const uniqueHeadings = headings.filter(function (heading, index, array) {
        return array.indexOf(heading) === index;
      });

      const items = buildItems(uniqueHeadings);

      if (items.length <= 1) {
        tocHost.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      tocHost.style.display = '';
      tocHost.innerHTML = '';

      const tocTitle = document.createElement('div');
      tocTitle.textContent = TOC_TITLE_TEXT;
      tocTitle.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      tocTitle.classList.add('toc-title');
      tocHost.appendChild(tocTitle);

      const tocLinksContainer = buildToc(items);
      tocHost.appendChild(tocLinksContainer);

      const divider = document.createElement('div');
      divider.classList.add('toc-divider');
      divider.setAttribute('role', 'presentation');
      tocHost.appendChild(divider);

      const links = Array.from(tocLinksContainer.querySelectorAll('a'));

      const sections = items
        .map(function (item) {
          return document.getElementById(item.id);
        })
        .filter(Boolean);

      let ticking = false;

      function updateActive() {
        ticking = false;

        let activeId = sections[0] ? sections[0].id : null;

        for (const section of sections) {
          const top = section.getBoundingClientRect().top - OFFSET;

          if (top <= 0) {
            activeId = section.id;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }

        links.forEach(function (link) {
          const isActive = link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + activeId;
          link.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
        });
      }

      function onScrollOrResize() {
        if (ticking) return;

        ticking = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(updateActive);
      }

      window.addEventListener('scroll', onScrollOrResize, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('resize', onScrollOrResize);
      window.addEventListener('hashchange', onScrollOrResize);

      const fontsReady = document.fonts && document.fonts.ready ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve();

      fontsReady.then(function () {
        requestAnimationFrame(updateActive);
      });
    }

    ready(run);
  })();
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const DEFAULT_BASE = window.location.origin + '/resources/webinars/';

    document.querySelectorAll('.cms-dynamic-link').forEach((container) => {
      const externalLink = container.getAttribute('data-external-link');
      const baseUrl = container.getAttribute('data-base-url');
      const utmParams = container.getAttribute('data-utm');

      const links = container.querySelectorAll('a');

      links.forEach((link) => {
        let finalHref = link.getAttribute('href'); // Default fallback from Webflow

        // :white_check_mark: Case 1: Use external link (always takes priority)
        if (externalLink && externalLink.trim() !== '') {
          finalHref = externalLink;

          // Append UTM if it's provided (non-empty)
          if (utmParams && utmParams.trim() !== '') {
            const separator = finalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
            finalHref += separator + utmParams.replace(/^\?/, '');
          }

          link.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
          link.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
        }

        // :white_check_mark: Case 2: No external, but use baseUrl for internal CMS content
        else if (baseUrl && baseUrl.trim() !== '') {
          finalHref = `${DEFAULT_BASE}${baseUrl}${utmParams ? utmParams : ''}`;
        }

        // :white_check_mark: Case 3: Only UTM present
        else if (utmParams && utmParams.trim() !== '') {
          const separator = finalHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
          finalHref += separator + utmParams.replace(/^\?/, '');
        }

        // Apply final href
        link.setAttribute('href', finalHref);
      });
    });
  });
</script>
